| Guideline                                                                                               | Explanation                                                                    |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Make sure that the hold-down bolts for the driver feet are loose before you make alignment corrections. | This makes it possible to move the driver when you make alignment corrections. |
| Check the alignment again after any mechanical adjustments.                                             | This corrects any misalignments that an adjustment may have caused.            |

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: You must have two dial indicators in order to complete this procedure.

section_path.title: Attach the dial indicators for alignment

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: Attach two dial indicators on the pump coupling half  (X):

section_path.title: Attach the dial indicators for alignment

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: Attach one indicator (P) so that the indicator rod comes into contact with the perimeter of  the driver coupling half  (Y).

section_path.title: Attach the dial indicators for alignment

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: This indicator is used to measure parallel misalignment.

section_path.title: Attach the dial indicators for alignment

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: Attach the other indicator (A) so that the indicator rod comes into contact with the inner end of the driver coupling half.

section_path.title: Attach the dial indicators for alignment

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: This indicator is used to measure angular misalignment.

section_path.title: Attach the dial indicators for alignment

blocks.section: Attach the dial indicators for alignment
blocks.content: Rotate the pump coupling half (X) in order to check that the indicators are in contact with the driver coupling half  (Y) but do not bottom out.

blocks.markdown:
| When the reading value is...   | Then...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|--------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Negative                       | The coupling halves are farther apart at the bottom than at the top. Perform one of these steps: • Add shims in order to raise the feet of the driver at the shaft end. • Remove shims in order to lower the feet of the driver at the other end. |
| Positive                       | The coupling halves are closer at the bottom than at the top. Perform one of these steps: • Remove shims in order to lower the feet of the driver at the shaft end. • Add shims in order to raise the feet of the driver at the other end.        |
